notes: A complete handwritten English letter leaf, signed R. Hartshorne, with manuscript page number 2 and archive number 54. No date, place, addressee or letter salutation appears on this leaf. The explicit author qualification is “I believe” in the claim that the artinian hypothesis on p. 38 is unnecessary under the stated AR-J-adic noetherian assumptions. The author presents an argument with three exact sequences, an inverse limit and Artin–Rees, and concludes by mentioning the paper “Affine Duality and Cofiniteness” and promising a copy. These are author claims, not proof results checked by this reader. Three paler comparison arrows have unidentified authorship. Four explicit C doubt locations are retained: the first shortened exponent, shews/shows, the unreadable deletion, and the isolated colon-like margin marks. The same shortened exponent recurs before Z and is handled as a recurring glyph. No substantive correction to C was established; rendering its pale arrows in gray is only a presentation change.
